class.name: MidiFileReader
class.brief_description: Resource holding raw MIDI bytes for FluidSynth playback.
class.description: MidiFileReader holds the raw bytes of a Standard MIDI File in [member data]. It is produced by the MIDI import plugin ([code]project/addons/midi/import_midi_plugin.gd[/code]) as [code].midstr[/code] and consumed by [AudioStreamPlaybackFluidSynth] via [code]fluid_player_add_mem[/code]. The resource travels through [code]ResourceLoader[/code] so songs can be bundled in exported games.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Replaces the internal byte array with a copy of [param data].

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns a copy of the internal MIDI bytes.

method.name: get_extension
method.description: Returns [code]"midstr"[/code], the extension used by the MIDI loader/saver.
